<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const OLD_DOMAIN = "dl.melody98.ir";
  const NEW_DOMAIN = "melody98.musitraf.com";
  const SET_PRELOAD = "auto";

  const OLD = OLD_DOMAIN.trim(), NEW = NEW_DOMAIN.trim();
  const ATTRS = [
    "href", "src", "poster", "data-src", "data-lazy-src",
    "data-original", "data-url", "data-href", "data-download"
  ];

  const SELECTOR = ATTRS.map(attr => `[${attr}]`).join(",");
  const escape = value => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  const END = "\\.?(?=[:/?#\\\\]|$)";

  const VALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const INVALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)(?:(?:https?:?)[\\\\/]*|[\\\\/]+)?" +
    escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const NEW_URL = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(NEW) + END,
    "i"
  );

  function rewrite(value) {
    if (
      !value ||
      !OLD ||
      !NEW ||
      !value.toLowerCase().includes(OLD.toLowerCase())
    ) return null;

    if (VALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        VALID,
        (_, space, prefix) => space + prefix + NEW
      );

    if (INVALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        INVALID,
        (_, space) => space + "https://" + NEW
      );

    return null;
  }

  const mediaToLoad = new Set();
  let scheduled = false;

  function reload(element) {
    const media = element.matches("audio,video")
      ? element
      : element.closest("audio,video");

    if (!media) return;

    media.preload = SET_PRELOAD;
    mediaToLoad.add(media);

    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      scheduled = false;

      mediaToLoad.forEach(media => {
        if (!media.isConnected || !media.paused) return;
        try { media.load(); } catch (_) {}
      });

      mediaToLoad.clear();
    }, 0);
  }

  function fix(element) {
    for (const attr of ATTRS) {
      if (!element.hasAttribute(attr)) continue;

      const oldValue = element.getAttribute(attr);
      const value = rewrite(oldValue);

      if (value !== null)
        element.setAttribute(attr, value);

      if (
        attr === "src" &&
        element.matches("audio,video,source") &&
        (value !== null || NEW_URL.test(oldValue))
      ) reload(element);
    }
  }

  function scan(root) {
    if (root.nodeType === 1 && root.matches(SELECTOR))
      fix(root);

    root.querySelectorAll(SELECTOR).forEach(fix);
  }

  scan(document);

  new MutationObserver(records => records.forEach(record => {
    if (record.type === "attributes") {
      fix(record.target);
    } else {
      record.addedNodes.forEach(node =>
        node.nodeType === 1 && scan(node)
      );
    }
  })).observe(document, {
    subtree: true,
    childList: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ATTRS
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const OLD_DOMAIN = "dl.melody98.ir";
  const NEW_DOMAIN = "melody98.musitraf.com";
  const SET_PRELOAD = "auto";

  const OLD = OLD_DOMAIN.trim(), NEW = NEW_DOMAIN.trim();
  const ATTRS = [
    "href", "src", "poster", "data-src", "data-lazy-src",
    "data-original", "data-url", "data-href", "data-download"
  ];

  const SELECTOR = ATTRS.map(attr => `[${attr}]`).join(",");
  const escape = value => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  const END = "\\.?(?=[:/?#\\\\]|$)";

  const VALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const INVALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)(?:(?:https?:?)[\\\\/]*|[\\\\/]+)?" +
    escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const NEW_URL = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(NEW) + END,
    "i"
  );

  function rewrite(value) {
    if (
      !value ||
      !OLD ||
      !NEW ||
      !value.toLowerCase().includes(OLD.toLowerCase())
    ) return null;

    if (VALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        VALID,
        (_, space, prefix) => space + prefix + NEW
      );

    if (INVALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        INVALID,
        (_, space) => space + "https://" + NEW
      );

    return null;
  }

  const mediaToLoad = new Set();
  let scheduled = false;

  function reload(element) {
    const media = element.matches("audio,video")
      ? element
      : element.closest("audio,video");

    if (!media) return;

    media.preload = SET_PRELOAD;
    mediaToLoad.add(media);

    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      scheduled = false;

      mediaToLoad.forEach(media => {
        if (!media.isConnected || !media.paused) return;
        try { media.load(); } catch (_) {}
      });

      mediaToLoad.clear();
    }, 0);
  }

  function fix(element) {
    for (const attr of ATTRS) {
      if (!element.hasAttribute(attr)) continue;

      const oldValue = element.getAttribute(attr);
      const value = rewrite(oldValue);

      if (value !== null)
        element.setAttribute(attr, value);

      if (
        attr === "src" &&
        element.matches("audio,video,source") &&
        (value !== null || NEW_URL.test(oldValue))
      ) reload(element);
    }
  }

  function scan(root) {
    if (root.nodeType === 1 && root.matches(SELECTOR))
      fix(root);

    root.querySelectorAll(SELECTOR).forEach(fix);
  }

  scan(document);

  new MutationObserver(records => records.forEach(record => {
    if (record.type === "attributes") {
      fix(record.target);
    } else {
      record.addedNodes.forEach(node =>
        node.nodeType === 1 && scan(node)
      );
    }
  })).observe(document, {
    subtree: true,
    childList: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ATTRS
  });
})();

  const OLD_DOMAIN = "dl.melody98.ir";
  const NEW_DOMAIN = "melody98.musitraf.com";
  const SET_PRELOAD = "auto";

  const OLD = OLD_DOMAIN.trim(), NEW = NEW_DOMAIN.trim();
  const ATTRS = [
    "href", "src", "poster", "data-src", "data-lazy-src",
    "data-original", "data-url", "data-href", "data-download"
  ];

  const SELECTOR = ATTRS.map(attr => `[${attr}]`).join(",");
  const escape = value => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  const END = "\\.?(?=[:/?#\\\\]|$)";

  const VALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const INVALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)(?:(?:https?:?)[\\\\/]*|[\\\\/]+)?" +
    escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const NEW_URL = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(NEW) + END,
    "i"
  );

  function rewrite(value) {
    if (
      !value ||
      !OLD ||
      !NEW ||
      !value.toLowerCase().includes(OLD.toLowerCase())
    ) return null;

    if (VALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        VALID,
        (_, space, prefix) => space + prefix + NEW
      );

    if (INVALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        INVALID,
        (_, space) => space + "https://" + NEW
      );

    return null;
  }

  const mediaToLoad = new Set();
  let scheduled = false;

  function reload(element) {
    const media = element.matches("audio,video")
      ? element
      : element.closest("audio,video");

    if (!media) return;

    media.preload = SET_PRELOAD;
    mediaToLoad.add(media);

    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      scheduled = false;

      mediaToLoad.forEach(media => {
        if (!media.isConnected || !media.paused) return;
        try { media.load(); } catch (_) {}
      });

      mediaToLoad.clear();
    }, 0);
  }

  function fix(element) {
    for (const attr of ATTRS) {
      if (!element.hasAttribute(attr)) continue;

      const oldValue = element.getAttribute(attr);
      const value = rewrite(oldValue);

      if (value !== null)
        element.setAttribute(attr, value);

      if (
        attr === "src" &&
        element.matches("audio,video,source") &&
        (value !== null || NEW_URL.test(oldValue))

    }
  }

  function scan(root) {
    if (root.nodeType === 1 && root.matches(SELECTOR))

    root.querySelectorAll(SELECTOR).forEach(fix);

        if (m98ir_audio.duration == 0) {
            return;
        } else {
            if (m98ir_scrolling) {
                m98ir_scrollTo = m98ir_audio.duration * (m98ir_scrollSlider.value / 1000);
                m98ir_audio.currentTime = m98ir_scrollTo;
            }
        }
    }
    function m98ir_scrollTimeUpdate() {
        if (m98ir_audio.duration) {
            if(!m98ir_scrolling){
                let updateScroll = m98ir_audio.currentTime * (1000 / m98ir_audio.duration);
                m98ir_scrollSlider.value = updateScroll;
            }
            var currentMins = Math.floor(m98ir_audio.currentTime / 60);
            var currentSecs = Math.floor(m98ir_audio.currentTime - currentMins * 60);
            var durationMins = Math.floor(m98ir_audio.duration / 60);
            var durationSecs = Math.floor(m98ir_audio.duration - durationMins * 60);
            if (currentSecs < 10) {
                currentSecs = "0" + currentSecs;
            }
            if (currentMins < 10) {
                currentMins = "0" + currentMins;
            }
            if (durationSecs < 10) {
                durationSecs = "0" + durationSecs;
            }
            m98ir_currentTimeText.innerHTML = currentMins + ":" + currentSecs;
        } else {
            m98ir_currentTimeText.innerHTML = "00" + ":" + "00";
        }
    }

        m98ir_set_reset_music_in_list();
        if(active_loop==false){
            if (m98ir_playlist_index == (m98ir_playlist.length - 1)) {
                m98ir_playlist_index = 0;
            } else {
                m98ir_playlist_index++;
            }
        }
        m98ir_fetchMusicDetails();

    function m98ir_getRandomNumber(min, max) {
        let step1 = max - min + 1;
        let step2 = Math.random() * step1;
        let result = Math.floor(step2) + min;
        return result;
    }
    function m98ir_random() {
        m98ir_set_reset_music_in_list();
        let randomIndex = m98ir_getRandomNumber(0, m98ir_playlist.length - 1);
        m98ir_playlist_index = randomIndex;
        m98ir_fetchMusicDetails();
    }
    function m98ir_select_from_list(new_index) {
        m98ir_playlist_index = new_index;
        m98ir_set_reset_music_in_list();
        m98ir_fetchMusicDetails();
        return false;
    }
    function ShowSongText(musicid,title){
        let songText=Mkia_MusicText[musicid];
        if(Mkia_MusicText[musicid]==""){
            songText="به زودی";
        }
        swal({
            title:title,
            text: songText,
            confirmButtonText: "بستن",
            showConfirmButton: true
        });
        return false;
    }

    "i"
  );

      !OLD ||
      !NEW ||

      return value.replace(
        VALID,
        (_, space, prefix) => space + prefix + NEW
      );

    if (INVALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        INVALID,
        (_, space) => space + "https://" + NEW
      );

    return null;
  }

  let scheduled = false;

  function reload(element) {
    const media = element.matches("audio,video")

    media.preload = SET_PRELOAD;
    mediaToLoad.add(media);

    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      scheduled = false;

    } else {

      );
    }

  });

  const SET_PRELOAD = "auto";

  const OLD = OLD_DOMAIN.trim(), NEW = NEW_DOMAIN.trim();
  const ATTRS = [
    "href", "src", "poster", "data-src", "data-lazy-src",
    "data-original", "data-url", "data-href", "data-download"
  ];

  const SELECTOR = ATTRS.map(attr => `[${attr}]`).join(",");
  const escape = value => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  const END = "\\.?(?=[:/?#\\\\]|$)";

  const VALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const INVALID = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)(?:(?:https?:?)[\\\\/]*|[\\\\/]+)?" +
    escape(OLD) + END,
    "i"
  );

  const NEW_URL = new RegExp(
    "^(\\s*)((?:https?:)?\\/{2})" + escape(NEW) + END,
    "i"
  );

  function rewrite(value) {
    if (
      !value ||
      !OLD ||
      !NEW ||
      !value.toLowerCase().includes(OLD.toLowerCase())
    ) return null;

    if (VALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        VALID,
        (_, space, prefix) => space + prefix + NEW
      );

    if (INVALID.test(value))
      return value.replace(
        INVALID,
        (_, space) => space + "https://" + NEW
      );

    return null;
  }

  const mediaToLoad = new Set();
  let scheduled = false;

  function reload(element) {
    const media = element.matches("audio,video")
      ? element
      : element.closest("audio,video");

    if (!media) return;

    media.preload = SET_PRELOAD;
    mediaToLoad.add(media);

    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      scheduled = false;

      mediaToLoad.forEach(media => {
        if (!media.isConnected || !media.paused) return;
        try { media.load(); } catch (_) {}
      });

      mediaToLoad.clear();
    }, 0);
  }

  function fix(element) {
    for (const attr of ATTRS) {
      if (!element.hasAttribute(attr)) continue;

      const oldValue = element.getAttribute(attr);
      const value = rewrite(oldValue);

      if (value !== null)
        element.setAttribute(attr, value);

      if (
        attr === "src" &&
        element.matches("audio,video,source") &&
        (value !== null || NEW_URL.test(oldValue))
      ) reload(element);
    }
  }

  function scan(root) {
    if (root.nodeType === 1 && root.matches(SELECTOR))
      fix(root);

    root.querySelectorAll(SELECTOR).forEach(fix);
  }

  scan(document);

  new MutationObserver(records => records.forEach(record => {
    if (record.type === "attributes") {
      fix(record.target);
    } else {

      );
    }

    subtree: true,
    childList: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ATTRS
  });
})();
